mathematical_premises: Weak convergence plus a common L-infinity density cap preserves that cap in the limit by Portmanteau and outer regularity.
For probability measures, the bounded-Lipschitz metric metrizes weak convergence.
L1 convolution belongs to C0; L-infinity*L1 Young inequality preserves a paid height.

Latest designated partner account02/B15 source-pinned at math-open-problems@dbd7533d035ea02a097cf9ff573e9a5d65038f7a proves ||p_R||inf<=2+3log2 for R=4XY+U^2+2UV+V^2/4 under arbitrary independent cap-one laws, and the stated one-sheet tent inequality.

new_results.statement: If mu_n=>mu, every mu_n has density p_n with ||p_n||inf<=M, and g is any fixed probability density, then mu has density p with ||p||inf<=M and ||p_n*g-p*g||inf->0; every convolved density lies in C0 and retains height <=M. The result extends to g_n->g in L1.
For a finite positive measure nu, nu<=M dx iff int (epsilon-|x-y|)_+ dnu(x)<=M epsilon^2 for every y and epsilon>0.
p_n=[1/2+(1/4)sin(pi n x)]1_[0,2] are cap-one probability densities converging weakly to (1/2)1_[0,2], while ||p_n-p||inf=1/4 for every n.

partner_result_actually_applied.application: For R=4XY+U^2+2UV+V^2/4, partner pays M_*=2+3log2. Adding an independent original-coordinate W^2 gives Q=R+W^2 with p_Q in C0 and ||p_Q||inf<=M_*. Under coordinatewise weak perturbation of the first four cap-one inputs, the smoothed output densities converge uniformly with the same height cap. The partner one-sheet tent inequality also yields the exact submeasure bound nu<=pi dx through the new tent certificate.

unresolved_implication: The full universal height remains open because a general s_3(A)>=1 matrix need not split in original coordinates into a universally paid receiver plus an independent additive AC smoothing block. A dimension-free aggregate-before-inversion/coupled receiver is still required before regularity compilers can finish the argument.
next_step: Seek a coupled analogue of the weak-height smoothing compiler that can retain a smoothing coordinate in the presence of original-coordinate cross terms, without conditioning to a worst-fibre cap; alternatively feed the compiler only after a grouped/ridge aggregate receiver has paid a universal height.
